item: Build the massing only, as a CLOSED BLOCK. The brick middle building is a full-depth box: a front wall, two side walls that run the WHOLE depth, and a back wall. The roof slab bears on all four of them - nothing may overhang more than 1.0 m past something that carries it. The parapet is a PERIMETER WALL standing on the roof slab, not a solid cap: the roof interior stays visible over it from the solved camera, and it is 0.3-1.2 m tall (role parapet). Add the three plain roof solids the target shows - one vent box and two pipes, 3 roof fixtures in total - as simple boxes and a revolve, nothing shaped. No openings, no trims, no ironwork, no colour work beyond putting each part in the right palette zone. Roles for this pass: massing for the walls, roof for the slab, parapet for the perimeter wall, roof_fixture for the vent and the pipes. Dimensions from subjects/facade_brick/layout.json: the W (your massing's x extent) and H (its y extent) you fix here are what the whole building is measured against, and the block's depth is the key massing.depthOverW - read it and multiply, do not invent a metre. Layout keys this pass must satisfy: massing.depthOverW, crown.height. Done looks like: the silhouette of the middle building in image 1, in the right proportions, standing on the ground, closed on every side, with a parapet you can see over. You may reopen any earlier part if the LOOK checklist for it failed; the previous review lists the failed rows.
answer: CHANGE: Replaced smoke geometry with closed massing, supported roof, perimeter parapet, and three roof fixtures; module gate passed; MISSING KEY massing.wallThickness, roof.thickness, crown.thickness, roof_fixture.size, roof_fixture.position.
